meaning: The clocks that the values of three scaffold-recordings builds belong to: agricultural science (no dip and no difference between the game and the simulator after its staged start), agricultural science with backed-up belts (no difference between the game and the simulator), and the inserters moved_open names for chemical science with a shared foundry. Each build is named as in scaffold-recordings.game.test.ts, its config by the ConfigPaths key; `clock_sha256` is the sha256 of the identity (clockIdentity) of the clock the generator selects for it. The game test refuses to run on another clock and scaffold-recordings-clock.generation.test.ts checks the selection (the two agricultural science builds on the generations of agricultural-science.generation.test.ts and clock-belt.generation.test.ts), so a clock that moves is found before those values are taken for the new clock's. The values of chemical science with a shared foundry were recorded on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 on its clock (1 output swing per cycle), whose hash was taken from the selection on 2026-10-23; no recording of the clock itself was kept. Both agricultural science builds select batched swings (5 output swings per cycle), one clock for both, with windows on the two inserters that take eggs out of the loop into the science biochamber since 2026-10-24: recorded on it that day, 400 in every one of 74 periods from the staged start, and no difference between the game and the simulator in what any inserter or machine moved (the same clock with those inserters always on was recorded the same day, 400 in every period from the staged start and from the prepared one; the 2-swing clock before that).
